evals.prompt: Use GTM_HOME seeded from dev/evals/fixtures/gtm-home. Research HarborFlow Logistics from this user-provided context: regional fulfillment company, 450 employees, three warehouses, WMS migration in progress, public page says it is hiring dock supervisors. Produce an account brief for outbound prioritization.
evals.expected_output: The account brief composes segmentation and scoring when useful, labels user-provided evidence, and returns a factual account-level research result.
expectations: Reads icps.md and workspace context before research
Uses account segmentation or a valid segment label
Uses account scoring when criteria are available
Separates evidence, inference, and open questions
Does not claim live facts beyond provided or sourced evidence

evals.prompt: Use GTM_HOME seeded from dev/evals/fixtures/gtm-home. Bulk research these accounts from a pasted list: HarborFlow Logistics, DockPilot Systems, ShopperBee. Include research priority and top risks for each.
evals.expected_output: Bulk account research returns a summary plus compact rows with priority, confidence, and provenance.
expectations: Includes priority distribution and segment distribution
Marks unverifiable claims as user-provided context or open questions
